success.description: As above, and any allies within long range add {Dm} to Discipline checks while this blessing is recharging

boon.description: While this blessing recharges, you and all allies within long range gain the Invigorated condition while engaged with an enemy

bane.description: While this blessing recharges, you and all allies within medium range gain the Fortuned condition while not engaged with an enemy, you cowards!

sigmarsComet.description: An ally within close range. That ally, inspired by your example, adds {Da} to the dice pool of his next action

reckless.requirements: S favour, Strength 4+ Effect Ulric fortfies your will and your commanding presence. While this blessing is recharging, you add {Dm} to Leadership checks
reckless.name: Duty Before Dishomour
